method.samples: Six independent paired blocks per configuration; three subpairs for each small configuration, one for Boids; explicit AB primers excluded before measurement.
method.order: AB/BA alternates across blocks and subpairs. Separate cohorts per configuration.
method.cache: Silex --nocache; a fresh temporary Zig linker cache per process, removed after acquisition; OS caches active.
method.scheduling: nice 10; default compiler workers, recorded per trace. One compilation at a time.
method.latency_effect: Median of all raw candidate process durations divided by median of all raw reference durations.
method.bootstrap: 10000 resamples of the six paired blocks, retaining all observations in each selected block; Python random.Random(20261104), rng.randrange(6) six times per draw; seed reset for each configuration.
method.latency_guard: Upper one-sided 95% ratio <=1.05, or upper absolute delta <=50ms when reference median <1s.
method.rss_guard: Maximum process RSS within each block; bootstrap median paired block ratios, upper one-sided 95% <=1.10. No averaging of RSS.
method.size_guard: Upper one-sided 95% <=1.10; all emitted hashes additionally identical.
method.stability: Reference point medians: range <=10% and half medians within factor1.05 when >=1s; otherwise absolute range and half delta <=50ms.
method.control_equivalence: C/C bilateral95% interval entirely inside +/-50ms for small entries or [1/1.05,1.05] otherwise. The former non-rejection of exact equality was not practical equivalence.
method.resource_guards: Start with free memory >=45%; stop below35% or process group >=4GiB; diagnostic timeout600s.
method.frontend: Trace nanoseconds; same raw-median and paired-block bootstrap; seed reset per phase. Nested phases not summed.
